title: The enemy doesn't have to destroy your marriage... he only has to divide it.
paragraphs: The enemy doesn't have to destroy your marriage... he only has to divide it.
Most marriages don't fall apart overnight.
They slowly drift.

One unspoken hurt.
One unresolved argument.
One compromise.
One prayer that was never prayed together.
Before long, two people who once stood side by side begin standing back to back.
The Bible reminds us:
"For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood..." — Ephesians 6:12
Your spouse is not your enemy.
But the enemy would love for you to believe they are.
📖 How to Protect Your Marriage From Spiritual Attack
This isn't another relationship book filled with worldly advice.
It's a biblical guide designed to help couples fight the real battle—together.
Inside you'll discover:

✅ How Satan quietly attacks Christian marriages
✅ Biblical ways to rebuild trust and unity
✅ How to recognize spiritual attacks before they become disasters
✅ Powerful prayers husbands and wives can pray together
✅ How forgiveness closes doors the enemy wants to keep open
✅ Communication habits that strengthen your covenant
✅ Biblical principles for protecting intimacy, family, and your home
✅ How to build a Christ-centered marriage that stands through every storm
⚔️ Most people fight their spouse.
Few people fight FOR their spouse.
Most people wait until their marriage is falling apart.
Few strengthen it before the storm comes.
Most people want a happy marriage.
Few intentionally build a holy one.
The question isn't whether your marriage will face challenges.
The question is:
Will you face them together—with Christ at the center?
